example.title: 17th Street Pier (Coast Guard and Bar Pilots pier)

brief: A heavy working pier into the river: a broad timber-decked pier with concrete deck patches, galvanised steel gates and a bollard plaque at the landward end, red-hulled Coast Guard cutters and pilot boats moored along it, fenced pile clusters and dolphins alongside. Two photos. Piles carried 10 m or more below the modelled bed (spec rule 4).
